title: Heewon Jeong has been accepted to the graduate program at KAIST
body: Heewon Jeong has been accepted to the graduate program in Industrial Design at KAIST. She will be moving on to her new environment starting in the spring semester of 2027. Congratulations on her achievement.

title: Jee Hee Lee has joined Design Media Lab
body: Jihee Lee has joined our lab as an M.S. student. She brings an impressive background in professional design practice, and we look forward to the design research she will take on here.

title: HapBraille Paper Published (SCIE Q1)
body: HapBraille: Designing a Non-Mechanical Braille Display Using Kilovolt-Range Electrovibration Feedback, first-authored by undergraduate researcher Heewon Jeong, has been published. The work was carried out over roughly a year starting in 2025, and appears in the International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction, an SCIE Q1 journal. Congratulations!
